source.title: I used NotebookLM to make a 'Family Wiki'— and now everything I need to run the household is a click away
source.author: Amanda Caswell

athena.directive: Architect and implement a Self-Sovereign Personal Knowledge Vault within the Creative Liberation Engine, providing immediate, context-aware, and highly organized access to all personal and household information, grounded entirely in user-owned data.
athena.rationale: The 'Family Wiki' concept, as demonstrated by NotebookLM, highlights a critical need for a centralized, intelligent system to manage the vast and diverse information streams of personal and household life. Current solutions are fragmented and lack the contextual intelligence required for rapid retrieval and synthesis. This directive aligns with Article I (Sovereignty) by prioritizing self-hosted data ownership and processing, and Article IV (Quality Standards) by aiming for a complete, integrated solution that eradicates information silos and enhances decision-making with zero human wait time, rather than an MVP.

options.title: Self-Sovereign Personal Knowledge Vault (Preferred)
options.description: Establish a dedicated, locally hosted, and encrypted knowledge vault. This system will ingest, process, and store all user-provided documents, media, and data through advanced OCR, multimodal processing, and semantic indexing. It will serve as the single source of truth for personal information, accessible via a conversational AI interface and a structured 'Notebook' system.
options.tradeoffs: High initial architectural complexity and resource demands for local infrastructure setup and data migration. Requires robust local processing capabilities for AI models. Potential user friction during initial data upload and organization.
options.architecture: Local vector database for semantic search, secure local storage with end-to-end encryption, robust data ingestion pipeline (OCR, audio-to-text, image recognition), multimodal AI models for embedding and summarization, agent orchestration (KEEPER for knowledge, VERA for data validation, BOLT for content generation) for retrieval and synthesis, API for local and secure integrations (e.g., local network drives).
options.design: Intuitive conversational UI for natural language queries, a 'Vault' dashboard with visually distinct 'Notebooks' (e.g., 'Family Health', 'Household Manuals', 'Financial Records'), visual timelines for event histories, interactive charts for data comparisons (e.g., health metrics), drag-and-drop document upload interface, clear privacy indicators and granular access controls for sharing.

options.title: Federated Personal Data Mesh
options.description: Instead of centralizing data, create a secure, distributed mesh that connects and queries existing personal data sources (e.g., Google Drive, local file systems, email archives) on demand. Data remains at its original location, with the Creative Liberation Engine acting as an intelligent query router and aggregator.
options.tradeoffs: Increased query latency due to distributed nature. Higher dependency on external service APIs, which compromises absolute sovereignty. Complex security model for managing permissions and access across disparate systems. Data consistency and deduplication can be challenging.
options.architecture: Secure, encrypted connectors/bridges for various data sources, a central RELAY agent for query routing and aggregation, federated search capabilities, distributed indexing (metadata only) rather than full content ingestion, granular access control policies at the source level.
options.design: Unified search bar with source filtering options, a visual representation of connected data 'nodes' and their health status, contextual suggestions based on the active application or user intent, a 'Data Map' to visualize where information resides, and clear indicators for data origin.

options.title: Intelligent Document & Media Ingestion Pipeline
options.description: Focus on perfecting the data ingestion process. Develop an advanced pipeline that automatically processes, categorizes, tags, and summarizes uploaded documents and media. This system would enrich raw data into structured, searchable knowledge assets within the Creative Liberation Engine's knowledge base.
options.tradeoffs: High computational cost for advanced AI processing (OCR, multimodal analysis). Requires continuous model training and updates for accuracy in categorization and summarization. Risk of AI misinterpretation or hallucination if not carefully validated by VERA.
options.architecture: Dedicated ingestion agent (AURORA for design, BOLT for build), advanced OCR engine with handwriting recognition, audio-to-text transcription, image recognition (object, text, facial), AI models for automatic semantic tagging, categorization, entity extraction, and summarization, outputting structured data and embeddings to KEEPER's knowledge graph.
options.design: Streamlined upload interface (drag-and-drop, email-to-ingest, mobile camera integration), real-time visual feedback on processing status, auto-generated tags and summaries displayed prominently, a 'Digest' view of recently ingested content, and user tools to refine or correct AI-generated metadata.

options.title: Conversational AI for Proactive Information & Reminders
options.description: Enhance the Creative Liberation Engine's conversational AI to proactively retrieve and present relevant information or generate reminders based on analysis of the user's personal knowledge vault, anticipating needs before explicit queries are made.
options.tradeoffs: Requires sophisticated predictive analytics and context understanding to avoid being intrusive. Privacy concerns around proactive data analysis must be addressed with robust safeguards and user consent. High development effort for accurate anticipation and timely delivery.
options.architecture: Integration with core conversational AI (Gemini), IRIS agent for execution of proactive tasks, KEEPER for deep knowledge retrieval, predictive analytics models for identifying upcoming needs (e.g., warranty expiration, medication refill), a rules engine for customizable notification triggers, secure API for delivering alerts.
options.design: Proactive notifications integrated subtly into the Creative Liberation Engine's notification center, contextual conversational prompts (e.g., 'Did you know your fridge warranty expires next month?'), a 'Daily Briefing' or 'Household Status' dashboard, and granular user controls for customizing alert types and frequency.

options.title: 'Digital Twin' of Physical Spaces & Objects
options.description: Extend the personal knowledge system to include a 'digital twin' representation of physical spaces and objects within the user's home. This allows linking physical items (e.g., appliances, furniture, rooms) to their digital documentation (manuals, warranties, repair history, paint codes, photos).
options.tradeoffs: Extremely high complexity for mapping physical-digital relationships and maintaining accuracy. Requires extensive data input for initial setup and ongoing updates. Potential for privacy concerns if pervasive sensing (IoT, computer vision) is used.
options.architecture: Integration with IoT devices and smart home platforms, a knowledge graph specializing in spatial and object relationships, computer vision capabilities for object recognition and spatial mapping, secure storage for 3D models and associated metadata, API for linking digital documents to physical entities.
options.design: Interactive 3D model of the user's home or specific rooms as a primary UI, ability to 'click' on a digital representation of a physical object to retrieve associated documents, augmented reality (AR) overlays to display information when viewing physical items through a camera, visual inventory management for household assets.

options.title: Secure Family Sharing and Collaboration
options.description: Implement robust, granular access control and secure sharing protocols within the Personal Knowledge Vault, enabling family members to collaborate on household management and access relevant information while maintaining individual privacy boundaries.
options.tradeoffs: Significant security and compliance overhead to ensure data integrity and prevent unauthorized access. Managing multiple user permissions and roles can be complex. Requires careful design to balance collaboration efficiency with individual data sovereignty.
options.architecture: Role-based access control (RBAC) system for 'Notebooks' and individual documents, secure key exchange protocols for shared content, blockchain-based audit logs for transparency of data access, LEX agent for managing legal/compliance aspects of data sharing, encrypted communication channels for collaborative features.
options.design: Intuitive user interface for inviting family members, setting granular permissions (read-only, edit, specific document access), visual indicators for shared data and pending requests, a transparent audit trail displaying who accessed or modified what information, and secure messaging within the sharing context.
